Subject: StrikeBox POC — proposed hands-on workshop (prompt review, routing, load tests)

Hi Olivia / Jakub —

Thanks again for the quick discovery call yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused hands-on workshop where we:
- Walk through your key prompts and prompt families (prompt review)
- Validate routing/intent rules against sample traffic
- Run a short load soak (target: 100 concurrent tokens/sec for 10m) to exercise batching and KV cache behavior

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2026-06-16 10:00–12:00
- Wed 2026-06-17 14:00–16:00
- Thu 2026-06-18 09:30–11:30 (preferred for Redwood infra team)

Agenda (60–90m hands-on + 30m recap):
1) Quick kickoff (10m) — goals and success criteria
2) Prompt walk-through & canonicalization (20–30m)
3) Routing config & test runs (20–30m)
4) Load soak and monitoring (10–20m)
5) Action items and next steps (15m)

Pre-reqs for the session:
- StrikeBox provides a representative test corpus (CSV or JSONL) and a list of high-priority intents
- Redwood provides a brief handoff checklist + load test plan (attached)

Can you confirm which of the proposed windows works best? If none, suggest two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Owners on our side: Aditya (routing + prompts), Dev Patel (load harness & infra), Marissa (facilitation + notes).

Thanks — looking forward.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: StrikeBox hands-on — post-session notes & action items (recap)

Hi Olivia / Jakub —

Great session today — thanks for the partnership and the excellent prompt examples. Below is a concise recap + owners / timelines. Recording and logs are in the Drive folder.

Recap highlights:
- Prompt canonicalization: we agreed to normalize greetings and entity tokens prior to routing to reduce model variance. Aditya captured examples in the routing doc.
- Routing behavior: early routing rules resolved ~82% of intents in the sample set; a small set of fallback prompts hit model confusion and will be flagged for annotation.
- Load soak: 12-minute run at 120 tokens/sec average, no OOMs; tail latency spiked briefly during a KV-cache warmup at ~2m and recovered once warm caches filled.

Action items: (owner — due)
- Aditya Rao — expand routing test cases to include edge prompts + add canary rule for ambiguous intents — due 2026-06-25 (file: routing_test_cases_v2.md)
- Dev Patel — publish finalized load-runner image and a runbook for customer teams; include token rotation steps — due 2026-06-21 (artifact: load-runner-v1.tar)
- Marissa Cole — consolidate session notes, highlight prompts for annotation, and schedule a 30m follow-up to prioritize annotation queue — due 2026-06-22 (invite to follow)
- StrikeBox (Olivia) — provide annotated examples for the 12 ambiguous prompts identified during the session — due 2026-06-24 (upload to Drive)

Attachments uploaded: session-recording-20260618.mp4, load-test-plan.pdf, strikebox_test_corpus_v1.csv

Next short sync — propose Tue 2026-06-23 10:00–10:30 PST to review routing_test_cases_v2 and annotation priorities. If that works for you, Marissa will send the invite.

Thanks again —
Mina
